lesson_title: Every Hillside Is a Stadium That Walks
hook_text: Roof, wall, stands, pitch — every Karoo koppie is built like a stadium. And the stadium is moving.
clip_script: Turn any South African hillside into a stadium and you will never misread one again. The rounded top is the roof — the crest, convex, slowly weathering smooth. Below it stands the wall — the cliff, bare rock, the steepest part of the hill. Geographers call it the free face, because everything the weather breaks loose falls away instantly; nothing stays behind to soften it, so it stays sheer. Under the wall slope the stands — the talus, a ramp of rubble that arranges itself at the steepest angle loose rock can hold, about 25 to 35 degrees, the same angle every dumped load of gravel chooses. Overload it and rock slides until the angle comes back — that is why it is dead straight. And then the pitch — the pediment, a gently curved rock floor running out to the plain, swept by sheets of rainwater. Roof weathers, wall drops rock, stands pass it down, pitch spreads it out. Now the strangest part: the stadium moves. The wall rebuilds itself one step back, the stands shuffle after it, the pitch stretches forward — and the shape never sags. Cliff stays sheer, ramp stays straight, floor stays flat, the whole profile walking backward through the landscape. Run that for fifty million years and the pitches of neighbouring hills weld into one vast floor — the pediplain — with the last unwalked hills standing on it as koppies. The Karoo is a country of walking stadiums, photographed mid-stride.
visual_style: A hillside cross-section morphing into a labelled stadium — roof, wall, stands, pitch stamping on in sequence — then the whole profile sliding backward in time-lapse, sweeping out a plain dotted with shrinking koppies.
mood: Sports-broadcast energy dissolving into deep-time awe.
pacing: Four quick beats for the four parts, then a long slow pull-back as the stadium walks.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and read every koppie you pass like a labelled diagram.
